markdown.ru: Члены семьи по-английски: **mother, father, sister, brother, grandmother, grandfather**.
markdown.en: Family members in English: **mother, father, sister, brother, grandmother, grandfather**.
markdown.tj: Аъзоёни оила ба англисӣ: **mother, father, sister, brother, grandmother, grandfather**.

markdown.ru: Для описания семьи используют глагол **have got**: I have got a sister.
markdown.en: To describe your family use **have got**: I have got a sister.
markdown.tj: Барои тавсифи оила **have got** истифода мешавад: I have got a sister.
